name: contract-static-forms
goal: Reject runtime test contracts for static configuration, style and type units.

evidence: Static config, style and type units can currently claim helper or class runtime cases.
The existing validator case checks entity forms but lacks static kinds with otherwise valid helper and method cases.
Test-only commit d6ff3d7404 rejects a config method case; the previous validator accepted it.
Commit 49e6477bcb rejects runtime cases on static units before accepting a test form.
Matched red a2212f8c435b and green 07477aca4cb5 keep the case, command and runtime unchanged.
